what_happened.line: The Select Board voted 4-0 to authorize the town manager to sign a revised regional dispatch agreement that adds Boxborough.
The board agreed to give the absent third Conservation Commission candidate one more week before making an appointment.
The town manager reported that the estimate for next year's health insurance had been lowered to the average of the range the trust announced; the actual renewal rate is due mid-February.
The board continued its draft board and commission handbook discussion, deferred the bylaw comparison until a full board is present, and left the remote participation policy for later.
The Feb 6 meeting was cancelled; the board will meet Jan 30 and Feb 13, with the Flat Hill Road topic set for Feb 13.

why_it_matters: The dispatch vote changes who shares the town's regional emergency dispatch service, which bears on how that service is run and paid for.
The health insurance estimate is a planning input for next year's town budget, and it stays an estimate until the renewal rate arrives in mid-February.
The Conservation Commission appointment is delayed a week, so who sits on the board that reviews local wetlands and land questions is not yet settled.
watch_next: The actual health insurance renewal rate, due mid-February.
The Conservation Commission appointment, expected after the one-week extension, and the Flat Hill Road topic on Feb 13.

reconciliation.what: Our minutes against the minutes the town published. caption_error = the same fact the captions rendered badly, resolved by the official reading shown beside the as-heard one; discrepancy = a substantive difference, flagged and not resolved. Neither record is treated as the referee.
reconciliation.summary: The two records agree on the one non-procedural vote (the dispatch agreement, 4-0) and on most decisions and attendees. They differ on several figures, mostly caption errors, plus one real discrepancy: the Council on Aging volunteer value, $224,000 in ours against about $24,000 in the official minutes. A person should check the recording at t=4508 for that figure.
